summary: Local usage ledger module and real-data UsagePanel for roadmap 121-128. Module is pure (no network, console, or file I/O); persistence and IPC wiring are left to the captain.
checks: npm ci --ignore-scripts in the worktree: completed, exit 0
npm test (full suite): 148 tests, 148 pass, 0 fail

UsageLedger.recordEvent: (input: unknown) => UsageEvent. Input: runtime 'local'|'cloud', provider slug, model, optional project/worker labels, inputTokens/outputTokens, optional generationMs/promptMs, optional at. Cloud events are priced when a price exists, otherwise costState 'unpriced'. Local events are costState 'not-applicable'.
UsageLedger.reserve: (input: unknown) => Reservation. Input: provider, model, maxInputTokens, maxOutputTokens, optional project/worker. Holds a conservative maximum cost until settled.
UsageLedger.settle: (reservationId: string, usage: unknown) => UsageEvent. Converts a reservation into one recorded cloud event; throws for unknown or already-settled ids.
UsageLedger.setPrices: (prices: unknown) => Price[]. User-entered table keyed by provider and model, USD per million tokens.
UsageLedger.declareBillingAdapter: (provider: unknown) => void. Marks a provider as having a billing adapter. Undeclared providers report 'unsupported'.
UsageLedger.recordBilling: (snapshot: unknown) => BillingSnapshot. Requires a declared provider. Stores observedAt, balance, spent, and resetsAt; unreported fields stay null.
UsageLedger.setBudget: (budget: unknown | null) => Budget | null. period 'day'|'month' in UTC, amount in USD, optional thresholds (default 0.5, 0.8, 1).
UsageLedger.report: () => UsageReport. estimatedSpend, reservedSpend, unpricedEvents, totals, byModel, attribution, billing (status observed|stale|unknown|unsupported, reset countdown), reservations, budget (conservative total, pace, alerts), disclaimer.
UsageLedger.performance: (options?: {model?: string; limit?: number}) => rows of tokensPerSecond from local events with timing, newest first.
UsageLedger.exportCsv: (options?: {from?: string; to?: string}) => {content, rows, truncated}. Max 5000 rows and 1 MB; spreadsheet formulas neutralised.
UsageLedger.exportJson: (options?: {from?: string; to?: string}) => {content, rows, truncated}. Same bounds; includes format, schemaVersion, disclaimer, and events.
UsageLedger.snapshot: () => UsageState. Plain JSON for the caller to persist.
UsageLedger.loadState: (raw: unknown) => {accepted, rejected}. Validates each stored row individually, applies retention, and drops billing for undeclared providers.

dependencies.runtime: node:crypto (randomUUID) for the module. None added to package.json.
dependencies.ui: react, @phosphor-icons/react (DownloadSimple), and src/ui/primitives (Badge, Button, Empty, Notice, Panel).
dependencies.types: UsagePanel imports types from electron/services/usage.ts via import type. The renderer does not import runtime code from electron.

limitations: No provider billing adapter is implemented. Every provider reports 'unknown' or 'unsupported' until the API owner registers an adapter that calls recordBilling. No balance or spend is fabricated.

The module is not wired into electron/backend.ts, chat.ts, IPC, preload, or App navigation. The captain must call recordEvent/parseOllamaMetrics after chat completions, persist snapshot()/loadState() through the store, and expose report/export over IPC.
Export is returned as a string. The captain must add the save dialog and file write in the trusted main process.
Prices are user-entered. Without a matching price a cloud event is 'unpriced' and excluded from the estimate, which the UI flags as partial.
Local events are tokens and timing only. Electricity and hardware costs are not estimated.
Reservations are never auto-expired. An interrupted call stays in the reserved total until settled, which is conservative. There is no dismiss action yet.
Anthropic usage field names (input_tokens/output_tokens) follow the documented Messages API shape. They were not checked against a live response, because this module made no network calls.
The development $300 ledger in the Control Room runtime was not read and is not included. This module is product-side only.

The UsagePanel component is not mounted anywhere and has no CSS classes of its own (usage-panel, usage-kv, usage-meter, usage-table, usage-alerts, usage-list, usage-note). The captain needs to add styles, or reuse existing ones.
Export bounds use compact JSON, so the 1 MB bound is measured in characters, which is equal to bytes for ASCII content.
captain_notes: Import createUsageLedger once in the backend and keep it alongside the store. Persist usage state under its own key or file, not inside contracts.ts AppState.
Call settle() from the cloud chat path only after a successful response. If the call fails or is interrupted, leave the reservation in place.
Use parseOllamaMetrics on the final chunk of local chat responses; it is the source for roadmap 127.
